question.problem: The radius of the base of a right cylinder is $3 \: \textrm{m}$ and its height is $6 \: \textrm{m}.$ Find the lateral surface area of the cylinder.
question.worked_solution:
We can calculate the lateral surface area of a cylinder using the formula

$$
S_L = 2\pi r h,
$$

where $r$ is the radius and $h$ is the height of the cylinder.

Substituting $r=3 \,\textrm{m}$ and $h=6 \,\textrm{m}$ into the formula, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}{S}_{L} & =2\pi (3)(6)=36\pi \,{\text{m}}^{2}.\end{aligned}
$$
